protocol.analysis: Post hoc; original square-resize test predictions; no retraining, no threshold changes
protocol.bootstrap: Class-stratified paired percentile bootstrap over image IDs; identical resamples for all ten seeds and both models. Average per-seed metric differences, NOT predictions, over the ten fixed fitted pairs. CI conditional on class counts and fitted models.
protocol.seed_ci: Student-t CI over ten paired seed differences; fixed test set; six two-sided paired t-tests with Holm correction
protocol.mcnemar: Exact two-sided binomial McNemar on paired multiclass correctness separately for each fixed seed model pair; Holm correction across ten seeds
protocol.limits: Image bootstrap assumes independent images; unavailable organoid/batch IDs prevent biological cluster resampling. Bootstrap intervals unadjusted across six metrics. Original five seeds inspected before extension; all inference exploratory. Repeated predictions are not 3000 independent samples.
